##### Project general facts

Omya Residence stands as a contemporary branded residential tower in Jebel Ali’s freehold enclave. The sleek façade embraces clean lines and practical elegance while framing open vistas toward Yalayis Street and the surrounding urban fabric. A mix of studios, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom homes offers efficient layouts that capture abundant natural light for a vibrant city‑centric lifestyle.  

Residents can keep fit in dedicated men’s and ladies’ gyms before cooling off in a main swimming pool complemented by a separate children’s pool and a jacuzzi. Leisure options extend to a splash‑pad, yoga platform, CrossFit zone, cinema, padel court, barbecue pavilion, outdoor lounge areas and a fireplace lounge perched on the pool deck. A children’s play zone and spacious seating terraces round out a lively environment that encourages both activity and relaxation.  

Interiors are appointed with refined finishes and premium materials, presenting a pure and timeless backdrop ready for personal touches. Kitchens are arranged as functional workspaces equipped to support everyday convenience. Bathrooms and living areas prioritize durability and contemporary appeal, ensuring a polished living experience throughout.  

##### Location description and benefits

Wasl Gate occupies a strategic corridor along Sheikh Zayed Road within the Jebel Ali district, granting swift access to the city’s main arteries. Its proximity to Energy Metro Station links commuters directly to Dubai Marina, Expo City and the international airports. The placement along this thoroughfare ensures effortless mobility for both work and leisure journeys.  

The neighbourhood blends residential towers, townhouses, parks, retail outlets and dining venues into a cohesive mixed‑use fabric. IKEA and Festival Plaza Mall serve as anchor points, offering extensive shopping, entertainment and essential services within strolling distance. Educational institutions, fitness centres and places of worship are interspersed throughout, creating a self‑contained ecosystem for families and professionals.  

Wide pedestrian walkways meander through landscaped green corridors, fostering a sense of openness and well‑being. Communal plazas and shaded seating invite spontaneous gatherings and leisurely evenings on private terraces. Together these elements craft an inclusive, connected lifestyle that balances urban dynamism with tranquil ambience.
